evidence: Adds the `IsSymlink` utility function in `src/util/fs_helpers.cpp` and `src/util/fs_helpers.h` to handle Windows reparse points.
rationale: It introduces a cross-platform filesystem helper in `util/fs_helpers` to work around GCC's `libstdc++` lack of symlink detection on Windows. This is a clean utility improvement that resolves broken standard library behavior on Windows.
